name: カテゴリ全体と個別会話の選択
prompt:
Recreate the compact Japanese Discord category and two channel rows shown in the primary native preview. Match the exact 390x208 canvas proportion, white background, layout and wording. This is a faithful reconstruction, not a redesign.

At the top left, place the muted small category label 「相談とアイデア」 around x15 y11. At the top right, place an empty 16px checkbox around x258 y8 and the muted label 「分類をフォロー」 starting near x282 y11.

First channel row: gray outline # glyph around x24 y65; bold dark 「地域からのお知らせ」 starting around x64 y59 in 14px type; smaller gray 「5日前に活動」 starting at x24 y91 in 12px type; selected forest-green rounded square checkbox with a small white check at x340 y64, about 24x24.

Second channel row: gray outline # glyph around x24 y144; bold dark 「活動の相談」 starting around x64 y138 in 14px type; smaller gray description 「地域の活動について相談する場所です。」 starting at x24 y169 in 12px type; selected forest-green rounded square checkbox at x340 y143, about 24x24. Maintain the native spacing between the two rows and the category header.

Keep the canvas plain white with no divider lines, card, shadow, extra row, emoji, or badge. Exact Japanese wording is important. No hyperlink text appears here: category and channel names are labels/selection targets, not hyperlinks, so keep them dark. If a real hyperlink label is visible, make the linked words blue. Do not recolor the green checkboxes blue.

Use the Japanese native preview as exact authority for composition, colors, checked states and copy. Use the original screenshot only as context for the category/channel list pattern. Exclude search, app header, other categories, additional channels and screen chrome.
reviewNotes: v001を実画像で目視。相談とアイデア、分類をフォロー、両チャンネルの日本語ラベル・活動/説明文・2つの選択済みチェックを保持。リンク文言なし。出力比率1717x916はnative390x208と一致する。カテゴリと2行の縦位置はnativeより約8〜11論理px低い。第2版でグループ全体を上へ動かす。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
